changes.title: UIMSD opens without blocking on saved-layout file reading
changes.text: UIMSD moves its saved column layout file read to the existing background history loader instead of holding the initial screen navigation. Saved layouts are applied together with the current catalog, preserving exact column order, source integrity and stale-load rejection.

changes.title: UIMSD Home summary calculation does not freeze rendering
changes.text: The initial Home statistics are prepared using the fully validated history catalog on its background thread, then reused only for matching catalog identity and ruleset scope. Later scope changes retain the authoritative computation. No statistics or historical events are skipped.

changes.title: Returning to title skips the unnecessary one-second black fade
changes.text: About, hero selection and APD News or Changes use the existing no-fade title return without avoiding real scene creation; non-title returns retain their normal behavior. The initial startup fade remains unchanged.

changes.title: Regression verification and preserved player data
changes.text: The complete 2097 core-method suite passed across 407 suites with zero failures, errors or skips. Tests cover both background UIMSD loading and saved column layout/scope consistency, title-return no-fade routing and retained historical run boundaries. Physical phone responsiveness is still unmeasured.

changes.title: Strict exact-source private paired APK build
changes.text: The immediate previous actually compiled developer TEST317 remains the build-history baseline. Preserve all 344 prior indexed history records byte for byte, append one reviewed record and verify matched developer/player history, signer, application identity, saves, core/debug and native evidence before acceptance. No public release.
